tasks.title: Conversation #12
tasks.transcript:
MEN: Will you be making the trip out to Los Angeles next Monday?
WOMAN: I was planning to, but something has come up, so I was contemplating whether or not I should delay my trip to the week after. Why do you ask?
MEN: My brother who moved to France five years ago is coming to LA next week on a business trip, so I was thinking of going out there to see him. And since I heard you are going, I thought maybe we could drive down together.
WOMAN: That sounds like a good idea. I do have to make a trip there, and it would be nice to have some company. Hmm...tell you what, I will see what I can do to take the trip next week after all. Let me give you a shout with the details after lunch today.

questions.stem: Why will the man take the trip?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士为什么要去旅行，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士说明出行目的的具体陈述。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士明确说“My brother...is coming to LA next week...so I was thinking of going out there to see him”，说明他出行的目的是去看望弟弟。 选项B：错误。 对话中提到的是男士的弟弟因出差去洛杉矶，而非男士本人要去开会，属于张冠李戴。 选项C：错误。 男士原本听说女士要去洛杉矶，想和她一起开车去，但这是他出行的方式而非目的。他出行的根本目的是看弟弟。 选项D：错误。 对话中完全没有提到男士要去见客户，属于无中生有。

questions.stem: What does the woman say she will let the man know about?

options.A: If she can go away with the man or not.
options.B: When she will be able to get back from LA.
options.C: How many people she will be going on the trip with.
options.D: Who will be accompanying her on the trip.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士说她会让男士知道什么事情，属于细节理解题，需抓住对话末尾女士明确提到的信息。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 女士说“I will see what I can do to take the trip next week after all. Let me give you a shout with the details after lunch today”，意思是她会想办法按原计划下周出行，并在午饭后告知男士具体情况，即她是否能和他一起出行。 选项B：错误。 女士并未提到要告知男士她何时能从洛杉矶回来，属于无关信息。 选项C：错误。 对话中没有提到其他人会一起出行，女士也没有要告知男士出行人数。 选项D：错误。 女士没有提到谁会陪她出行，她要告知的是自己能否按原计划下周出行。
